tools.name: find_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Ranks live x402 endpoints for a task such as 'web search', 'token price' or 'pdf to text'. Returns up to 10 endpoints ranked by text match, 7-day liveness probes and on-chain USDC payers with farmed wallets removed. Not charged when nothing matches.

tools.name: x402_endpoint_card
tools.description: Trust card for one x402 endpoint URL: 7-day uptime from our probes, latency, last success, price, and the seller's on-chain USDC payers over 30 days, with farmed wallets removed. Not charged for unknown URLs.

tools.name: find_apify_actors
tools.description: Picks Apify Store actors for a scraping or automation task such as 'instagram posts' or 'google maps places'. Returns up to 10 actors ranked by text match, 30-day users and run success rate, with per-event price and an x402 run URL. Not charged when nothing matches.

tools.name: x402_seller_check
tools.description: Demand check for one Base x402 seller by payTo address, endpoint URL or host: on-chain USDC payers over up to 30 days, how many remain after removing small-funded wallets and market scanners, repeat buyers, USDC received, and how much depends on one wallet. Not charged for unknown or unmeasured sell

tools.name: lp_real_yield_pools
tools.description: Real yield of Base Uniswap v3, Aerodrome and Aero concentrated-liquidity pools: fee APR against LVR (loss-versus-rebalancing), with staking rewards and rebalancing costs, measured from on-chain swaps. Shows where a headline APR is lost to arbitrage. Not charged when nothing matches.

tools.name: lp_real_yield_pool
tools.description: Real-yield card for one Base concentrated-liquidity pool address: headline fee APR, LVR, net yield at a reference range, fee-to-LVR ratio with a confidence interval, and volatility. Not charged for unknown pools.

tools.name: cartographer_status
tools.description: Free: price, network and data freshness of this server's paid tools.
